notes:
SCCM Retro 2.24.0

Controllers
- Wii U Pro Controller face buttons are mapped correctly.
- Motion controls can be inverted per axis on the remap screen (Wii, 3DS).
- Stick directions can be bound to buttons, and Shake and Recenter are bindable.

Emulators
- Wii U now runs with V-Sync on, which removes the tearing.
- 3DS motion no longer drifts on its own.
- Multi-disc games show as one item instead of one per disc.

Overlay and display
- Per-game overlay settings now actually apply.
- Readings are grouped by CPU, GPU and RAM, with a new bar layout across the top.
- 720p added to the docked resolutions.

Sound
- Bluetooth headphones are used automatically when connected.
- Docked volume is remembered across a reboot.

Storage and achievements
- Games dropped on the SD card no longer come back as duplicates.
- Achievements now work on Dreamcast and PS1 disc images.
- Upload shaders from the web page, and import Miis under Saves.
